<h2 id="extending_veo_videos" data-text="Extending Veo videos" tabindex="-1">Extending Veo videos</h2>
<aside class="note"><strong>Note:</strong><span> This feature is available for Veo 3.1 &amp; Veo 3.1 Fast models only, not
Veo 3.1 Lite.</span></aside>
<p>Use Veo 3.1 to extend videos that you previously generated with Veo by 7 seconds
and up to 20 times.</p>

<p>Input video limitations:</p>

<ul>
<li>Veo-generated videos only up to 141 seconds long.</li>
<li>Gemini API only supports video extensions for Veo-generated videos.</li>
<li>The video should come from a previous generation, like 
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">operation.response.generated_videos[0].video</code></li>
<li>Videos are stored for 2 days, but if a video is referenced for extension,
its 2-day storage timer resets. You can only extend videos that were generated
or referenced in the last two days.</li>
<li>Input videos are expected to have a certain length, aspect ratio, and dimensions:
<ul>
<li>Aspect ratio: 9:16 or 16:9</li>
<li>Resolution: 720p</li>
<li>Video length: 141 seconds or less</li>
</ul></li>
</ul>

<p>The output of the extension is a single video combining the user input video and
the generated extended video for up to 148 seconds of video.</p>

<p>This example takes the a Veo-generated video, shown here with
its original prompt, and extends it using the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">video</code> parameter and a new
prompt:</p>

<table class="fixed">
<thead>
   <tr>
     <th>Prompt</th>
 <th>Output: <code translate="no" dir="ltr">butterfly_video</code></th>
   </tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
  <tr>
    <td>
      An origami butterfly flaps its wings and flies out of the french doors into the garden.
    </td>
    <td>
        <img src="https://storage.googleapis.com/generativeai-downloads/images/Butterfly_original.gif"
                alt="Origami butterfly flaps its wings and flies out of the french doors into the garden.">
    </td>
  </tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python_8" data-text="Python" tabindex="-1">Python</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">time</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-kn">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">google</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">Client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">()</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">prompt</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Track the butterfly into the garden as it lands on an orange origami flower. A fluffy white puppy runs up and gently pats the flower."</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">operation</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">models</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">generate_videos</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"veo-3.1-generate-preview"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">video</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">operation</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">response</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">generated_videos</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-mi">0</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">]</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">video</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># This must be a video from a previous generation</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">prompt</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">prompt</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">config</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">types</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">GenerateVideosConfig</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-n">number_of_videos</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-mi">1</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-n">resolution</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"720p"</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-p">),</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Poll the operation status until the video is ready.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-k">while</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-ow">not</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">operation</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">done</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-nb">print</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Waiting for video generation to complete..."</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">time</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">sleep</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-mi">10</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">operation</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">operations</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">get</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">operation</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Download the video.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-n">video</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">operation</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">response</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">generated_videos</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-mi">0</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">]</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">files</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">download</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">file</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">video</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">video</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">destination</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"veo3.1_extension.mp4"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-nb">print</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Generated video saved to veo3.1_extension.mp4"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>

<span class="devsite-syntax-kd">const</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">prompt</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Track the butterfly into the garden as it lands on an orange origami flower. A fluffy white puppy runs up and gently pats the flower."</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1">// butterflyVideo must be a video from a previous generation</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-c1">// available as an object like { videoBytes: "...", mimeType: "video/mp4" }</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-kd">let</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">operation</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">await</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">ai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">models</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">generateVideos</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">({</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"veo-3.1-generate-preview"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">video</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">butterflyVideo</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">prompt</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">prompt</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">config</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">        </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">numberOfVideos</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-mf">1</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">        </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">resolution</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"720p"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">},</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">});</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1">// Poll the operation status until the video is ready.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-k">while</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">!</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">operation</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">done</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">console</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">log</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Waiting for video generation to complete..."</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">await</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-ow">new</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nb">Promise</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">((</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">resolve</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span>&gt;<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">setTimeout</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">resolve</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-mf">10000</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">));</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">operation</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">await</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">ai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">operations</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">getVideosOperation</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">({</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">        </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">operation</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">operation</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">});</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1">// Download the video.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-nx">ai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">files</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">download</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">({</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">file</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">operation</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">response</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">generatedVideos</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-mf">0</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">].</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">video</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">downloadPath</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"veo3.1_extension.mp4"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">});</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-nx">console</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">log</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-sb">`Generated video saved to veo3.1_extension.mp4`</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">);</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
<section><h3 id="go_8" data-text="Go" tabindex="-1">Go</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Go"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">package</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">main</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s">"context"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s">"log"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s">"os"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s">"time"</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s">"google.golang.org/genai"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-kd">func</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">main</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">()</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">ctx</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">context</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">Background</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">()</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">err</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">genai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">NewClient</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">ctx</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kc">nil</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">if</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">err</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">!=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kc">nil</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">        </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">log</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">Fatal</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">err</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">prompt</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s">`Track the butterfly into the garden as it lands on an orange origami flower. A fluffy white puppy runs up and gently pats the flower.`</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-c1">// butterflyVideo must be a video from a previous generation</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-c1">// available as a *genai.Video object.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kd">var</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">butterflyVideo</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">*</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">genai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">Video</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">operation</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">_</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">Models</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">GenerateVideos</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">        </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">ctx</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">        </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s">"veo-3.1-generate-preview"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">        </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">prompt</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kc">nil</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-c1">// image</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">butterflyVideo</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">        </span>&amp;<span class="devsite-syntax-nx">genai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">GenerateVideosConfig</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">      </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">NumberOfVideos</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-mi">1</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">      </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">Resolution</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s">"720p"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">},</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-c1">// Poll the operation status until the video is ready.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">for</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">!</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">operation</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">Done</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">        </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">log</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">Println</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s">"Waiting for video generation to complete..."</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">        </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">time</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">Sleep</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-mi">10</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">*</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">time</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">Second</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">        </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">operation</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">_</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">Operations</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">GetVideosOperation</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">ctx</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">operation</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kc">nil</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-c1">// Download the video.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">video</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">operation</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">Response</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">GeneratedVideos</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-mi">0</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">]</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">Files</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">Download</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">ctx</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">video</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">Video</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kc">nil</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">fname</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">:=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s">"veo3.1_extension.mp4"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">_</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">os</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">WriteFile</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">fname</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">video</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">Video</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">VideoBytes</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-mo">0644</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">log</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">Printf</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s">"Generated video saved to %s\n"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">fname</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
<section><h3 id="rest_7" data-text="REST" tabindex="-1">REST</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Bash"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Note: This script uses jq to parse the JSON response.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># It assumes butterfly_video_base64 contains base64-encoded</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># video data from a previous generation.</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># GEMINI API Base URL</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-nv">BASE_URL</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta"</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Send request to generate video and capture the operation name into a variable.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-nv">operation_name</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">$(</span>curl<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>-s<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">${</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">BASE_URL</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">/models/veo-3.1-generate-preview:predictLongRunning"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span>-H<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"x-goog-api-key: </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">$GEMINI_API_KEY</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span>-H<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Content-Type: application/json"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span>-X<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"POST"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span>-d<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">    "instances": [{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">      "prompt": "Track the butterfly into the garden as it lands on an orange origami flower. A fluffy white puppy runs up and gently pats the flower.",</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">      "video": {"inlineData": {"mimeType": "video/mp4", "data": "'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">$butterfly_video_base64</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'"}}</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">    }],</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">    "parameters": {</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">      "numberOfVideos": 1,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">      "resolution": "720p"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">    }</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">  }'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">|</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>jq<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>-r<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>.name<span class="devsite-syntax-k">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Poll the operation status until the video is ready</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-k">while</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>true<span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">do</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Get the full JSON status and store it in a variable.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">status_response</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">$(</span>curl<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>-s<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>-H<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"x-goog-api-key: </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">$GEMINI_API_KEY</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">${</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">BASE_URL</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">/</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">${</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">operation_name</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Check the "done" field from the JSON stored in the variable.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">is_done</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">$(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nb">echo</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">${</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">status_response</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">|</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>jq<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>.done<span class="devsite-syntax-k">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">if</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">${</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">is_done</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"true"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">]</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">then</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Extract the download URI from the final response.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">video_uri</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">$(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nb">echo</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">${</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">status_response</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">|</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>jq<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>-r<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'.response.generateVideoResponse.generatedSamples[0].video.uri'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nb">echo</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Downloading video from: </span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">${</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">video_uri</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Download the video using the URI and API key and follow redirects.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span>curl<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>-L<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>-o<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>veo3.1_extension.mp4<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>-H<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"x-goog-api-key: </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">$GEMINI_API_KEY</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">${</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">video_uri</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">break</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">fi</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Wait for 10 seconds before checking again.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span>sleep<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-m">10</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-k">done</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
</devsite-selector></div>
<p><devsite-video video-id="eSF7-_B4ciA" title="Reference"></devsite-video></p>

<p>For information about writing effective text prompts for video generation, see
the <a href="#extend-prompt">Veo prompt guide</a>.</p>

<h2 id="handling-asynchronous-operations" data-text="Handling asynchronous operations" tabindex="-1">Handling asynchronous operations</h2>

<p>Video generation is a computationally intensive task. When you send a request
to the API, it starts a long-running job and immediately returns an <code translate="no" dir="ltr">operation</code>
object. You must then poll until the video is ready, which is indicated by the
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">done</code> status being true.</p>

<p>The core of this process is a polling loop, which periodically checks the job&#39;s
status.</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python_9" data-text="Python" tabindex="-1">Python</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">time</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-kn">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">google</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-kn">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">google.genai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">types</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">Client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">()</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># After starting the job, you get an operation object.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-n">operation</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">models</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">generate_videos</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">model</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"veo-3.1-generate-preview"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">prompt</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"A cinematic shot of a majestic lion in the savannah."</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Alternatively, you can use operation.name to get the operation.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-n">operation</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">types</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">GenerateVideosOperation</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">name</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">operation</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">name</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># This loop checks the job status every 10 seconds.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-k">while</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-ow">not</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">operation</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">done</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">time</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">sleep</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-mi">10</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Refresh the operation object to get the latest status.</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Send request to generate video and capture the operation name into a variable.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-nv">operation_name</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">$(</span>curl<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>-s<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">${</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">BASE_URL</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">/models/veo-3.1-generate-preview:predictLongRunning"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span>-H<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"x-goog-api-key: </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">$GEMINI_API_KEY</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span>-H<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Content-Type: application/json"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span>-X<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"POST"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span>-d<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">    "instances": [{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">        "prompt": "A cinematic shot of a majestic lion in the savannah."</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">      }</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">    ]</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-s1">  }'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">|</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>jq<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>-r<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>.name<span class="devsite-syntax-k">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># This loop checks the job status every 10 seconds.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-k">while</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>true<span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">do</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Get the full JSON status and store it in a variable.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">status_response</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">$(</span>curl<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>-s<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>-H<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"x-goog-api-key: </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">$GEMINI_API_KEY</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">${</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">BASE_URL</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">/</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">${</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">operation_name</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Check the "done" field from the JSON stored in the variable.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">is_done</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">$(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nb">echo</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">${</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">status_response</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">|</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>jq<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>.done<span class="devsite-syntax-k">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">if</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">${</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">is_done</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"true"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">]</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">then</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Once done, the result is in status_response.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># ... process and download your video ...</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nb">echo</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Video generation complete."</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">break</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">fi</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Wait for 10 seconds before checking again.</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nb">echo</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Waiting for video generation to complete..."</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span>sleep<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-m">10</span>

<h2 id="veo-model-parameters" data-text="Veo API parameters and specifications" tabindex="-1">Veo API parameters and specifications</h2>

<p>These are the parameters you can set in your API request to control the video
generation process.</p>

  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th>Parameter</th>

      <td class="row-gray" colspan="5">Instances</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">prompt</code>:<br>The text description for the video. Supports audio cues.</td>
      <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">string</code></td>
      <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">string</code></td>
      <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">string</code></td>
      <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">string</code></td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">image</code>:<br>An initial image to animate.</td>
      <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">Image</code> object</td>

      <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">Image</code> object</td>
      <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">Image</code> object</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">lastFrame</code>:<br>The final image for an interpolation video to transition. Must be used in combination with the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">image</code> parameter.</td>
      <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">Image</code> object</td>
      <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">Image</code> object</td>
      <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">Image</code> object</td>
      <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">Image</code> object</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">referenceImages</code>:<br>Up to three images to be used as style and content references.</td>
      <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">VideoGenerationReferenceImage</code> object</td>
      <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">n/a</code> object</td>

      <td>n/a</td>

    <tr>

      <td>n/a</td>
      <td>n/a</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td class="row-gray" colspan="5">Parameters</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">aspectRatio</code>:<br>The video's aspect ratio.</td>
      <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">"16:9"</code> (default),<br><code translate="no" dir="ltr">"9:16"</code><br><br></td>
      <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">"16:9"</code> (default),<br><code translate="no" dir="ltr">"9:16"</code></td>
      <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">"16:9"</code> (default),<br><code translate="no" dir="ltr">"9:16"</code></td>
      <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">"16:9"</code> (default),<br><code translate="no" dir="ltr">"9:16"</code></td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">durationSeconds</code>:<br>Length of the generated video.</td>
      <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">"4"</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"6"</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"8"</code>.<br><br><i> Must be "8" when using extension, reference images or with 1080p and 4k resolutions</i></td>
      <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">"4"</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"6"</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"8"</code>.<br><br><i> Must be "8" when using reference images or with 1080p</i></td>
      <td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">"4"</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"6"</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"8"</code>.<br><br><i> Must be "8" when using extension, reference images or with 1080p and 4k resolutions</i></td>

      (See <a href="#limitations">Limitations</a> for region restrictions)</td>
      <td>

        <br>Image-to-video: <br><code translate="no" dir="ltr">"allow_adult"</code>, and <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"dont_allow"</code>

      </td>
      <td>Unsupported</td>

<p>Note that the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">seed</code> parameter is also available for Veo 3 models.
It doesn&#39;t guarantee determinism, but slightly improves it.</p>

<h2 id="limitations" data-text="Limitations" tabindex="-1">Limitations</h2>

<ul>
<li><strong>Multi-video prompting:</strong> Referencing or reasoning across multiple videos is not currently supported. Attempting multi-video prompting may result in degraded model performance or unexpected outputs.</li>
<li><strong>Language support:</strong> English (EN) is fully supported, but other languages have not been evaluated, so they may work but results can vary.</li>
<li><strong>Request latency:</strong> Min: 11 seconds; Max: 6 minutes (during peak hours).</li>
<li><strong>Regional limitations:</strong> In EU, UK, CH, MENA locations, the following
are the allowed values for <code translate="no" dir="ltr">personGeneration</code>:
<ul>
<li>Veo 3 and 3.1: <code translate="no" dir="ltr">allow_adult</code> only.</li>
<li>Veo 2: <code translate="no" dir="ltr">dont_allow</code> and <code translate="no" dir="ltr">allow_adult</code>. Default is <code translate="no" dir="ltr">dont_allow</code>.</li>
</ul></li>
<li><strong>Video retention:</strong> Generated videos are stored on the server for 2 days,
after which they are removed. To save a local copy, you must download your
video within 2 days of generation. Extended videos are treated as newly
generated videos.</li>
<li><strong>Watermarking:</strong> Videos created by Veo are watermarked using <a href="https://deepmind.google/technologies/synthid/">SynthID</a>, our tool for watermarking
and identifying AI-generated content. Videos can be verified using the
<a href="https://deepmind.google/science/synthid/">SynthID</a> verification platform.</li>
<li><strong>Safety:</strong> Generated videos are passed through safety filters and
memorization checking processes that help mitigate privacy, copyright and
bias risks.</li>
<li><strong>Audio error:</strong> Veo 3.1 will sometimes block a video from generating
because of safety filters or other processing issues with the audio. You
will not be charged if your video is blocked from generating.</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="prompt-guide" data-text="Veo prompt guide" tabindex="-1">Veo prompt guide</h2>

<p>This section contains examples of videos you can create using Veo, and shows you
how to modify prompts to produce distinct results.</p>

<h3 id="safety-filters" data-text="Safety filters" tabindex="-1">Safety filters</h3>

<p>Veo applies safety filters across Gemini to help ensure that
generated videos and uploaded photos don&#39;t contain offensive content.
Prompts that violate our <a href="/gemini-api/docs/usage-policies#abuse-monitoring">terms and guidelines</a> are blocked.</p>

<h3 id="basics" data-text="Prompt writing basics" tabindex="-1">Prompt writing basics</h3>

<p>Good prompts are descriptive and clear. To get the most out of Veo, start with
identifying your core idea, refine your idea by adding keywords and modifiers,
and incorporate video-specific terminology into your prompts.</p>

<p>The following elements should be included in your prompt:</p>

<ul>
<li><strong>Subject</strong>: The object, person, animal, or scenery that you want in your
video, such as <em>cityscape</em>, <em>nature</em>, <em>vehicles</em>, or <em>puppies</em>.</li>
<li><strong>Action</strong>: What the subject is doing (for example, <em>walking</em>, <em>running</em>, or
<em>turning their head</em>).</li>
<li><strong>Style</strong>: Specify creative direction using specific film
style keywords, such as <em>sci-fi</em>, <em>horror film</em>, <em>film noir</em>, or animated
styles like <em>cartoon</em>.</li>
<li><strong>Camera positioning and motion</strong>: [Optional] Control the camera&#39;s location
and movement using terms like <em>aerial view</em>, <em>eye-level</em>, <em>top-down shot</em>,
<em>dolly shot</em>, or <em>worms eye</em>.</li>
<li><strong>Composition</strong>: [Optional] How the shot is framed, such as <em>wide shot</em>,
<em>close-up</em>, <em>single-shot</em> or <em>two-shot</em>.</li>
<li><strong>Focus and lens effects</strong>: [Optional] Use terms like <em>shallow focus</em>,
<em>deep focus</em>, <em>soft focus</em>, <em>macro lens</em>, and <em>wide-angle lens</em> to achieve
specific visual effects.</li>
<li><strong>Ambiance</strong>: [Optional] How the color and light contribute to the scene,
such as <em>blue tones</em>, <em>night</em>, or <em>warm tones</em>.</li>
</ul>

<h4 id="more-tips" data-text="More tips for writing prompts" tabindex="-1">More tips for writing prompts</h4>

<ul>
<li><strong>Use descriptive language</strong>: Use adjectives and adverbs to paint a clear
picture for Veo.</li>
<li><strong>Enhance the facial details</strong>: Specify
facial details as a focus of the photo like using the word <em>portrait</em> in
the prompt.</li>
</ul>

<p><em>For more comprehensive prompting strategies, visit <a href="/gemini-api/docs/prompting-intro">Introduction to
prompt design</a>.</em></p>

<h3 id="audio" data-text="Prompting for audio" tabindex="-1">Prompting for audio</h3>

<p>You can provide Veo with cues for sound effects, ambient noise, and dialogue.
The model captures the nuance of these cues to generate a synchronized
soundtrack.</p>

<ul>
<li><strong>Dialogue:</strong> Use quotes for specific speech. (Example: &quot;This must be the
key,&quot; he murmured.)</li>
<li><strong>Sound Effects (SFX):</strong> Explicitly describe sounds. (Example: tires
screeching loudly, engine roaring.)</li>
<li><strong>Ambient Noise:</strong> Describe the environment&#39;s soundscape. (Example: A faint,
eerie hum resonates in the background.)</li>
</ul>

<p>These videos demonstrate prompting Veo 3&#39;s audio generation with increasing
levels of detail.</p>

   <tr>
     <th width="60%"><strong>Prompt</strong></th>

Two exhausted hikers, a man and a woman, push through ferns when the man stops abruptly, staring at a tree. Close-up: Fresh, deep claw marks are gouged into the tree's bark. Man: (Hand on his hunting knife) "That's no ordinary bear." Woman: (Voice tight with fear, scanning the woods) "Then what is it?" A rough bark, snapping twigs, footsteps on the damp earth. A lone bird chirps.</td>

<h3 id="use-reference-images" data-text="Prompting with reference images" tabindex="-1">Prompting with reference images</h3>

<p>You can use one or more images as inputs to guide your generated videos, using
Veo&#39;s <a href="/gemini-api/docs/veo#generate-from-images">image-to-video</a>
capabilities. Veo uses the input image as the initial frame. Select an image
closest to what you envision as the first scene of your video to animate
everyday objects, bring drawings and paintings to life, and add movement and
sound to nature scenes.</p>

<table class="fixed">
<thead>
   <tr>
     <th width="60%"><strong>Prompt</strong></th>
     <th width="40%"><strong>Generated output</strong></th>
   </tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
  <tr>
    <td><b>Input image (Generated by Nano Banana)</b><br>A hyperrealistic macro photo of tiny, miniature surfers riding ocean waves inside a rustic stone bathroom sink. A vintage brass faucet is running, creating the perpetual surf. Surreal, whimsical, bright natural lighting.</td>
    <td>
        <img src="https://storage.googleapis.com/generativeai-downloads/images/Sink_Surfers.png"
                alt="Tiny, miniature surfers riding ocean waves inside a rustic stone bathroom sink.">
    </td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td><b>Output Video (Generated by Veo 3.1)</b><br>A surreal, cinematic macro video. Tiny surfers ride perpetual, rolling waves inside a stone bathroom sink. A running vintage brass faucet generates the endless surf. The camera slowly pans across the whimsical, sunlit scene as the miniature figures expertly carve the turquoise water.</td>
    <td>
        <img src="https://storage.googleapis.com/generativeai-downloads/images/sink_surfers.gif"
                alt="Tiny surfers circling the waves in a bathroom sink.">
    </td>
  </tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<p>Veo 3.1 lets you <a href="/gemini-api/docs/veo#reference-images">reference images</a> or
ingredients to direct your generated
video&#39;s content. Provide up to three asset images of a single person, character,
or product. Veo preserves the subject&#39;s appearance in the output video.</p>

<table class="fixed">
<thead>
   <tr>
     <th width="60%"><strong>Prompt</strong></th>
     <th width="40%"><strong>Generated output</strong></th>
   </tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
  <tr>
    <td><b>Reference image (Generated by Nano Banana)</b><br>A deep sea angler fish lurks in the deep dark water, teeth bared and bait glowing.</td>
    <td>
        <img src="https://storage.googleapis.com/generativeai-downloads/images/angler_fish.png"
                alt="A dark and glowing angler fish">
    </td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td><b>Reference image (Generated by Nano Banana)</b><br>A pink child's princess costume complete with a wand and tiara, on a plain product background.</td>
    <td>
        <img src="https://storage.googleapis.com/generativeai-downloads/images/princess_dress.png"
                alt="A childs pink princess constume">
    </td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td><b>Output Video (Generated by Veo 3.1)</b><br>Create a silly cartoon version of the fish wearing the costume, swimming and waving the wand around.</td>
    <td>
        <img src="https://storage.googleapis.com/generativeai-downloads/images/angler_princess.gif"
                alt="An angler fish wearing a princess costume">
    </td>
  </tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<p>Using Veo 3.1, you can also generate videos by specifying the <a href="/gemini-api/docs/veo#using-first-and-last-video-frames">first and last
frames</a> of the video.</p>

<table class="fixed">
<thead>
   <tr>
     <th width="60%"><strong>Prompt</strong></th>
     <th width="40%"><strong>Generated output</strong></th>
   </tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
  <tr>
    <td><b>First image (Generated by Nano Banana)</b><br>A high quality photorealistic front image of a ginger cat driving a red convertible racing car on the French riviera coast.</td>
    <td>
        <img src="https://storage.googleapis.com/generativeai-downloads/images/ginger_race_cat.jpeg"
                alt="A ginger cat driving a red convertible racing car">
    </td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td><b>Last image (Generated by Nano Banana)</b><br>Show what happens when the car takes off from a cliff.</td>
    <td>
        <img src="https://storage.googleapis.com/generativeai-downloads/images/race_cat_cliff.jpeg"
                alt="A ginger cat driving a red convertible goes off a cliff">
    </td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td><b>Output Video (Generated by Veo 3.1)</b><br>Optional</td>
    <td>
        <img src="https://storage.googleapis.com/generativeai-downloads/images/race_cat_cliff.gif"
                alt="A cat drives of a cliff and takes off">
    </td>
  </tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<p>This feature gives you precise control over your shot&#39;s composition by letting
you define the starting and ending frame. Upload an image or use a frame from a
previous video generation to make sure your scene begins and concludes exactly
as you envision it.</p>

<h3 id="extend-prompt" data-text="Prompting for extension" tabindex="-1">Prompting for extension</h3>

<p>To <a href="/gemini-api/docs/veo#extending_veo_videos">extend</a> your Veo-generated
video with Veo 3.1 (not available for Veo 3.1 Lite), use the video as an input
along with an optional text prompt. Extend finalizes the final second or 24
frames of your video and continues the action.</p>

<p>Note that voice is not able to be effectively extended if it&#39;s not present in
the last 1 second of video.</p>

<table class="fixed">
<thead>
   <tr>
     <th width="60%"><strong>Prompt</strong></th>
     <th width="40%"><strong>Generated output</strong></th>
   </tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
  <tr>
    <td><b>Input video (Generated by Veo 3.1)</b><br>The paraglider takes off from the top of the mountain and starts gliding down the mountains overlooking the flower covered valleys below.</td>
    <td>
        <img src="https://storage.googleapis.com/generativeai-downloads/images/Paraglider.gif"
                alt="A paraglider takes off from the top of a mountain">
    </td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td><b>Output Video (Generated by Veo 3.1)</b><br>Extend this video with the paraglider slowly descending.</td>
    <td>
        <img src="https://storage.googleapis.com/generativeai-downloads/images/Paraglider_Extend.gif"
                alt="A paraglider takes off from the top of a mountain, then slowly descends">
    </td>
  </tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<h3 id="examples" data-text="Example prompts and output" tabindex="-1">Example prompts and output</h3>

<p>This section presents several prompts, highlighting how descriptive details can
elevate the outcome of each video.</p>

<h4 id="icicles" data-text="Icicles" tabindex="-1">Icicles</h4>

<p>This video demonstrates how you can use the elements of
<a href="#basics">prompt writing basics</a> in your prompt.</p>

<table class="fixed">
<thead>
   <tr>
     <th width="60%"><strong>Prompt</strong></th>
     <th width="40%"><strong>Generated output</strong></th>
   </tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
  <tr>
    <td>Close up shot (composition) of melting icicles (subject) on a frozen
    rock wall (context) with cool blue tones (ambiance), zoomed in
    (camera motion) maintaining close-up detail of water drips (action).
    </td>
    <td>
        <img src="https://storage.googleapis.com/generativeai-downloads/images/Icicles.gif"
                alt="Dripping icicles with a blue background.">
    </td>
  </tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<h4 id="man-on-the-phone" data-text="Man on the phone" tabindex="-1">Man on the phone</h4>

<p>These videos demonstrate how you can revise your prompt with increasingly
specific details to get Veo to refine the output to your liking.</p>

<table class="fixed">
<thead>
   <tr>
     <th width="60%"><strong>Prompt</strong></th>
     <th width="40%"><strong>Generated output</strong></th>
   </tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
  <tr>
    <td><b>Less detail</b><br>The camera dollies to show a close up of a desperate man in
    a green trench coat. He's making a call on a rotary-style wall phone with a
    green neon light. It looks like a movie scene.</td>
    <td>
        <img src="https://storage.googleapis.com/generativeai-downloads/images/Desperate_Man.gif"
                alt="Man talking on the phone.">
    </td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
  <td><b>More detail</b><br>A close-up cinematic
    shot follows a desperate man in a weathered green trench coat as he dials a
    rotary phone mounted on a gritty brick wall, bathed in the eerie glow of a
    green neon sign. The camera dollies in, revealing the tension in his jaw and
    the desperation etched on his face as he struggles to make the call. The
    shallow depth of field focuses on his furrowed brow and the black rotary
    phone, blurring the background into a sea of neon colors and indistinct
    shadows, creating a sense of urgency and isolation.</td>
    <td>
        <img src="https://storage.googleapis.com/generativeai-downloads/images/detail_call.gif"
                alt="Man talking on the phone">
    </td>
  </tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<h4 id="snow-leopard" data-text="Snow leopard" tabindex="-1">Snow leopard</h4>

<table class="fixed">
<thead>
   <tr>
     <th width="60%"><strong>Prompt</strong></th>
     <th width="40%"><strong>Generated output</strong></th>
   </tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
  <tr>
    <td><b>Simple prompt:</b><br>A cute creature with snow leopard-like fur is walking in winter
forest, 3D cartoon style render.</td>
    <td>
        <img src="https://storage.googleapis.com/generativeai-downloads/images/snowleopard.gif"
                alt="Snow leopard is lethargic.">
    </td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td><b>Detailed prompt:</b><br>Create a short 3D animated scene in a joyful cartoon style. A cute
creature with snow leopard-like fur, large expressive eyes, and a friendly,
rounded form happily prances through a whimsical winter forest. The scene should
feature rounded, snow-covered trees, gentle falling snowflakes, and warm
sunlight filtering through the branches. The creature's bouncy movements and
wide smile should convey pure delight. Aim for an upbeat, heartwarming tone with
bright, cheerful colors and playful animation.</td>
    <td>
        <img src="https://storage.googleapis.com/generativeai-downloads/images/snow-run.gif"
                alt="Snow leopard is running faster.">
    </td>
  </tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<h3 id="element-examples" data-text="Examples by writing elements" tabindex="-1">Examples by writing elements</h3>

<p>These examples show you how to refine your prompts by each basic element.</p>

<h4 id="subject" data-text="Subject and context" tabindex="-1">Subject and context</h4>

<p>Specify the main focus (subject) and the background or environment (context).</p>

<table class="fixed">
<thead>
   <tr>
     <th width="60%"><strong>Prompt</strong></th>
     <th width="40%"><strong>Generated output</strong></th>
   </tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
  <tr>
    <td>An architectural rendering of a white concrete apartment building with flowing organic  shapes, seamlessly blending with lush greenery and futuristic elements</td>
    <td>
        <img src="https://storage.googleapis.com/generativeai-downloads/images/architecture.gif"
                alt="Placeholder.">
    </td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>A satellite floating through outer space with the moon and some
stars in the background.</td>
    <td>
        <img src="https://storage.googleapis.com/generativeai-downloads/images/satellite.gif"
                alt="Satellite floating in the atmosphere.">
    </td>
  </tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<h4 id="action" data-text="Action" tabindex="-1">Action</h4>

<p>Specify what the subject is doing (e.g., walking, running, or turning their
head).</p>

<table class="fixed">
<thead>
   <tr>
     <th width="60%"><strong>Prompt</strong></th>
     <th width="40%"><strong>Generated output</strong></th>
   </tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
  <tr>
    <td>A wide shot of a woman walking along the beach, looking content and
relaxed towards the horizon at sunset.</td>
    <td>
        <img src="https://storage.googleapis.com/generativeai-downloads/images/sunset.gif"
                alt="Sunset is absolutely beautiful.">
    </td>
  </tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<h4 id="style" data-text="Style" tabindex="-1">Style</h4>

<p>Add keywords to steer the generation toward a specific aesthetic (e.g., surreal,
vintage, futuristic, film noir).</p>

<table class="fixed">
<thead>
   <tr>
     <th width="60%"><strong>Prompt</strong></th>
     <th width="40%"><strong>Generated output</strong></th>
   </tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
  <tr>
    <td>Film noir style, man and woman walk on the street, mystery,
cinematic, black and white.</td>
    <td>
        <img src="https://storage.googleapis.com/generativeai-downloads/images/noir.gif"
                alt="Film noir style is absolutely beautiful.">
    </td>
  </tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<h4 id="camera-motion" data-text="Camera motion and composition" tabindex="-1">Camera motion and composition</h4>

<p>Specify how the camera moves (POV shot, aerial view, tracking drone view) and
how the shot is framed (wide shot, close-up, low angle).</p>

<table class="fixed">
<thead>
   <tr>
     <th width="60%"><strong>Prompt</strong></th>
     <th width="40%"><strong>Generated output</strong></th>
   </tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
  <tr>
    <td>A POV shot from a vintage car driving in the rain, Canada at night,
cinematic.</td>
    <td>
        <img src="https://storage.googleapis.com/generativeai-downloads/images/car-pov.gif"
                alt="Sunset is absolutely beautiful.">
    </td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>Extreme close-up of a an eye with city reflected in it.</td>
    <td>
        <img src="https://storage.googleapis.com/generativeai-downloads/images/eye.gif"
                alt="Sunset is absolutely beautiful.">
    </td>
  </tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<h4 id="ambiance" data-text="Ambiance" tabindex="-1">Ambiance</h4>

<p>Color palettes and lighting influence the mood. Try terms like &quot;muted orange
warm tones,&quot; &quot;natural light,&quot; &quot;sunrise,&quot; or &quot;cool blue tones.&quot;</p>

<table class="fixed">
<thead>
   <tr>
     <th width="60%"><strong>Prompt</strong></th>
     <th width="40%"><strong>Generated output</strong></th>
   </tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
  <tr>
    <td>A close-up of a girl holding adorable golden retriever puppy in the park, sunlight.</td>
    <td>
        <img src="/static/gemini-api/docs/video/images/ambiance_puppy.gif"
                alt="A puppy in a young girl's arms.">
    </td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td>Cinematic close-up shot of a sad woman riding a bus in the rain, cool blue tones, sad mood.</td>
    <td>
        <img src="/static/gemini-api/docs/video/images/ambiance_sad.gif"
                alt="A woman riding on a bus that feels sad.">
    </td>
  </tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<h3 id="aspect-ratios" data-text="Aspect ratios" tabindex="-1">Aspect ratios</h3>

<p>Veo lets you specify the aspect ratio for your video.</p>

<table class="fixed">
<thead>
   <tr>
     <th width="60%"><strong>Prompt</strong></th>
     <th width="40%"><strong>Generated output</strong></th>
   </tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
  <tr>
    <td><b>Widescreen (16:9)</b><br>Create a video with a tracking drone view of a man driving a red convertible car in Palm Springs, 1970s, warm sunlight, long shadows.</td>
    <td>
        <img src="/static/gemini-api/docs/video/images/widescreen_palm_springs.gif"
                alt="A man driving a red convertible car in Palm Springs, 1970s style.">
    </td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td><b>Portrait (9:16)</b><br>Create a video highlighting the smooth motion of a majestic Hawaiian waterfall within a lush rainforest. Focus on realistic water flow, detailed foliage, and natural lighting to convey tranquility. Capture the rushing water, misty atmosphere, and dappled sunlight filtering through the dense canopy. Use smooth, cinematic camera movements to showcase the waterfall and its surroundings. Aim for a peaceful, realistic tone, transporting the viewer to the serene beauty of the Hawaiian rainforest.   </td>
    <td>
        <img src="/static/gemini-api/docs/video/images/waterfall.gif"
                alt="A majestic Hawaiian waterfall in a lush rainforest.">
    </td>
  </tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<p>Veo Fast versions allow developers to create videos with sound while maintaining
high quality and optimizing for speed and business use cases. They&#39;re ideal for
backend services that programmatically generate ads, tools for rapid A/B testing
of creative concepts, or apps that need to quickly produce social media content.</p>

and the <a href="https://aistudio.google.com/apps/bundled/veo_studio">Veo 3.1 applet</a>.</li>
